recruit.title: Expedition Map
recruit.radiant: Recruit a permanent. Make it Radiant.

ping.title: Ping
ping.radiant: Pierce. Deal {ping} damage. If this kills a Unit, summon a Ghoul Token with its stats.

burn.title: Steady Shot
burn.base: Deal {shot} damage to the enemy hero.
burn.radiant: Deal {shot} damage to the enemy hero. This permanently deals 2 more damage.

stitching.title: Stitching
stitching.base: Discover two ({stitchCost}) Cost or less Units. Fuse them.
stitching.radiant: Discover two Radiant ({stitchCost}) Cost or less Units. Fuse them.

armor.title: Armor Up
armor.base: Your hero gains {armor} Armor until your next turn.
armor.radiant: Your hero gains {armor} Armor, then this power refreshes.

insect.title: Die Insect
insect.base: Deal {insect} damage to a random enemy.
insect.radiant: Lucky 1. Deal {insect} damage to a random enemy.

brainstorm.title: KY Brainstorm
brainstorm.base: Add a random KY card to your hand. Reduce the cost of all Spells in your hand by ({discount}).
brainstorm.radiant: Add a Radiant KY card to your hand. Reduce the cost of all Spells in your hand by ({discount}).

pluck.title: Pluck
pluck.base: Add a random Fruit to your hand. It costs ({fruitCost}).
pluck.radiant: Add a random Radiant Fruit to your hand. It costs ({fruitCost}).

tricks.title: Terminus Tricks
tricks.radiant: Discover a Radiant Trap to summon.
